proposed_reports.title: Main Estimates / Budget principal 2026–2027
proposed_reports.publisher: Department of Finance and Treasury Board, Province of New Brunswick
proposed_reports.description: The province's annual Main Estimates presenting the financial plan of estimated revenues and expenditures for the fiscal year ending 31 March 2027, including ordinary, capital and special-purpose accounts and the comparative statement of estimated revenue by source.

proposed_reports.title: Estimates of Revenue and Expenditures 2026-2027
proposed_reports.publisher: Department of Finance and Affordability, Government of Prince Edward Island
proposed_reports.description: The operating budget estimates of revenue and expenditure detailing the province's spending plans by department for the fiscal year commencing 1 April 2026.

proposed_reports.title: Estimates of the Program Expenditure and Revenue of the Consolidated Revenue Fund 2026-27
proposed_reports.publisher: Department of Finance, Government of Newfoundland and Labrador
proposed_reports.description: The annual Estimates presenting program expenditure and revenue of the Consolidated Revenue Fund for the fiscal year 2026-27, tabled as supplementary information to the Budget Address.

proposed_reports.title: Budget 2026-27: Defending Nova Scotia
proposed_reports.publisher: Department of Finance and Treasury Board, Government of Nova Scotia
proposed_reports.description: The province's annual budget documents including the Budget Address, Estimates and Supplementary Detail, Highlights, Government Business Plan and four-year fiscal projections for the 2026-27 fiscal year.

proposed_reports.title: 2026/27 Budget and Business Plan
proposed_reports.description: The annual municipal operating budget ($1.45 billion) and capital budget ($316.7 million) approved by Regional Council, setting tax rates and funding municipal services for the fiscal year.

proposed_reports.title: Property Assessment Roll and Notices (Property Valuation Services Corporation)
proposed_reports.description: Annual delivery of the Assessment Roll to Nova Scotia's 49 municipalities and Property Assessment Notices to property owners, used by municipalities to set property tax rates under the Assessment Act.

proposed_reports.title: Property Assessments (Municipal Assessment Agency)
proposed_reports.description: Annual real property assessments provided to over 230 municipalities (excluding the City of St. John's) under the Assessment Act, 2006, forming the basis for municipal property tax levies.
